title: mentha arvensis var. palustris
intro: Mentha arvensis var. palustris, commonly known as Marsh Pennyroyal, is a perennial plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae) and is native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as relief from digestive issues, fever reduction, and its antiseptic properties make it useful in wound care. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Pennyroyal include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and act as a natural insect repellent. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aromatherapeutic uses.
